headline: Know your powers.
Train your mind.
Become more.
paras: Long before “mindset” was a buzzword, Christian D. Larson set out to map every force a person has – the conscious mind, the subconscious, will, imagination, character and faith – and to show, step by step, how to use them in daily life.

This beautifully designed annotated edition keeps the complete 1912 text, including the first appearance of Larson’s famous “Promise Yourself” – the creed millions know as The Optimist Creed – and adds what today’s reader needs to put it into practice.
bullets: A reflection and a practice after every chapter
A guided 30-day practice with space to write
Larson’s life and the world of New Thought
